senses.example: No hay comida en la nevera.
senses.exampleGloss: There is no food in the fridge.

senses.example: La comida está lista a las dos.
senses.notes: In Spain la comida is the main midday meal, much later than in Britain.

alternatives.reason: The evening meal, much later in Spain.
The first meal of the day.
In Spain a mid-morning bite, not lunch.

notes: comida means food and also the midday meal, the main meal in Spain.
